question: Which civil defense system experienced a false alarm in computing in 2026?
answer: The Brazilian civil defense system ("Defesa Civil Alerta") experienced a false alarm on June 19-20, 2026, when approximately 30 million people across eight Brazilian states received a false "Extreme Alert" notification containing only the word "misanthropy". The system had been breached by an external actor.
